status_summary: FERC did not change course on its long-term regional transmission planning and cost allocation rule (Order No. 1920, issued in 2024). On 2025-04-11 it issued Order No. 1920-B, published 2025-04-28, which addressed rehearing and sustained the rule's key requirements. FERC has since extended compliance dates for several regions; its schedule page updated 2026-08-19 lists first compliance filings from December 2025 through June 2027. In a 2026-09-25 filing, PJM's transmission owners and state entities proposed filing dates of 2026-11-19 and 2026-12-22 for cost allocation, and noted that Fourth Circuit petitions on the rule were argued on 2026-09-15 and remain pending.

timeline.event: FERC issued Order No. 1920-B on rehearing, sustaining the transmission planning rule; published in the Federal Register on 2025-04-28.
Federal Register notice of a 2026-06-04 joint motion by PJM state entities and transmission owners for more time to agree on a PJM cost allocation method.
PJM transmission owners, state entities and PJM filed a motion proposing November and December 2026 filing dates after failing to agree on cost allocation.
